policy.title: Privacy notice
policy.text: Privacy notice Harbour Fixtures Ltd (RC 123456), 12 Marina, Lagos, is the data controller for personal data collected on this website. Our Data Protection Officer is Ngozi Eze. Contact the DPO at dpo@fixtures.test. Why we use your data and our lawful basis We process personal data to provide insurance quotes and manage policies, on the lawful basis of contract, legal obligation and, for marketing, your consent, under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. Who we share it withWe share data with our reinsurers, payment providers and analytics providers acting as processors. How long we keep itWe retain policy records for six years after the policy ends, then delete them. Transfers outside NigeriaSome providers are in the United States and Ireland. We transfer personal data outside Nigeria only with adequate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, as the NDPA requires. Your rightsYou have the right to access, rectify, erase and port your data, to object, and to withdraw consent at any time. To make a request, email privacy@fixtures.test or use our rights request form. ComplaintsYou may lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).
